Class NetpbmFormatImage

java.lang.Object
bg.tu_varna.sit.cs.f24621858.image.format.Image
bg.tu_varna.sit.cs.f24621858.image.format.netpbm.NetpbmFormatImage
public class NetpbmFormatImage extends Image
Represents a Netpbm format image (PBM / PGM / PPM in ASCII or binary encoding).

Extends Image with Netpbm-specific metadata:

  • MagicWord – identifies the exact format variant (P1–P6).
  • maxPixelValue – the maximum value any channel can hold. Always 1 for PBM (P1/P4), in range [1, 65535] for PGM/PPM.
Author:
Dmitro Dashchenko

  • Constructor Details

    • NetpbmFormatImage

      public NetpbmFormatImage(String name, MagicWord magicWord, int width, int height, int maxPixelValue, int channels) throws InvalidImageDataException
      Constructs a NetpbmFormatImage with all required metadata.
      Parameters:
      name - file path or logical name of the image
      magicWord - Netpbm format variant (P1–P6)
      width - image width in pixels
      height - image height in pixels
      maxPixelValue - maximum channel value; must be in [0, 65535]
      channels - number of bytes in one pixel
      Throws:
      InvalidImageDataException - if maxPixelValue is outside the valid range or the base class validation fails

    • getMagicWord

      public static MagicWord getMagicWord(FileInputStream fileInputStream) throws IllegalArgumentException, IOException
      reads only the first token (the magic word), then closes the stream. The rest of the file is left unread.
      Parameters:
      fileInputStream - path to the Netpbm file
      Returns:
      magic word, e.g. "P6"
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if magicWord is invalid
      IOException - if the file cannot be opened or read

    • getPixelFormat

      public static PixelFormat getPixelFormat(MagicWord magicWord)
